title: A method for intracerebroventricular cannulation of young broiler chicks
author: Lamberigts, Song, et al.
materials: For injections, artificial cerebrospinal fluid (aCSF) was used as vehicle solution: 119 mM NaCl (Carl Roth GmBh, Karlsruhe, Germany), 25.2 mM NaHCO3 (Sigma-Aldrich, Saint Louis, MO, USA), 2.5 mM KCl (Honeywell Riedel-de-Haën AG, Seelze, Germany), 1 mM NaH2PO4 (Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany), 1.3 MgCl2 (Merck KGaA) and 10 mM glucose (Sigma-Aldrich). Prepare and sterilize aCSF with 0.1% Evans Blue dye (Sigma-Aldrich). The dye is added to facilitate the localization of injection site.

steps.title: Prepare artificial CSF solution
steps.instruction: Make artificial cerebrospinal fluid (aCSF) containing 119 mM NaCl (Carl Roth GmBh), 25.2 mM NaHCO₃ (Sigma‑Aldrich), 2.5 mM KCl (Honeywell Riedel‑de‑Haën AG), 1 mM NaH₂PO₄ (Merck KGaA), 1.3 mM MgCl₂ (Merck KGaA) and 10 mM glucose (Sigma‑Aldrich); sterilize and add 0.1 % Evans Blue dye (Sigma‑Aldrich) for injection site visualization.

steps.title: Fast chicks and ready equipment
steps.instruction: Withhold feed from chicks for 4 h before anesthesia; set up the stereotaxic instrument so the animal will be centered; disinfect the working area; organize and sterilize all surgical tools, instruments and disposables; heat sterile physiological saline to 42 °C; turn on the heating pad and stabilize its temperature at 40‑42 °C.

steps.title: Sedate chick with Zoletil
steps.instruction: Weigh each 7‑8 day old broiler chick (≈90‑120 g) and inject intramuscularly Zoletil (tiletamine + zolazepam; Virbac) at 6.5 mg per kg body weight; while sedation takes effect, clip head feathers with curved‑bladed mayo scissors and confirm sedation by toe or comb pinch.

steps.title: Position chick in stereotaxic frame
steps.instruction: Place the sedated chick prone on an underpad atop the heating pad; insert the left ear bar tip into the left auditory canal (just enough to hold the skull) and the right ear bar tip into the right canal; center the head, fix ear bars, clamp the beak and adjust height until the skull surface is horizontal and the zygomatic bone aligns with the ear bars; clean the head with 70 % ethanol swabs, change to fresh sterile gloves and cover the body with a surgical field.

steps.title: Apply local anesthetic and incise scalp
steps.instruction: Apply a topical 2 % xylocaine gel to the scalp, lift the skin with sterile tweezers and cut a midline incision with scissors or a scalpel; spread the incision open to expose the skull.

steps.title: Expose skull and clear tissue
steps.instruction: Use a sterile Q‑tip to remove blood and connective tissue until the skull is dry and bregma is clearly visible.

steps.title: Scratch skull surface for adhesion
steps.instruction: Gently scratch the skull surface with a sterile surgical blade in a checkered pattern to improve adhesion of the later dental cement cap.

steps.title: Drill skull anchor holes
steps.instruction: With a dental drill and a 1 mm drill bit, drill three holes in a triangular array around the intended cannula site, applying warm sterile physiological saline to reduce heat; drill as deep as possible without penetrating the skull completely; clear saline and blood with sterile Q‑tips.

steps.title: Insert anchoring screws
steps.instruction: Using tweezers and an appropriate screwdriver, screw the anchoring screws into the drilled holes, avoiding contact with or irritation of the dura and ensuring the screws are not flush against the skull.

steps.title: Place guide cannula above bregma
steps.instruction: Attach a guide cannula (with dummy cannula inserted) to the stereotaxic arm and position it directly above bregma.

steps.title: Adjust cannula coordinates
steps.instruction: Move the guide cannula 2.0 mm anterior and 0.3 mm lateral from bregma.

steps.title: Pierce dura and insert cannula
steps.instruction: Pierce the dura at the insertion site with a sterile 21‑gauge needle, then slowly lower and insert the guide cannula to the desired depth.

steps.title: Prepare dental cement mixture
steps.instruction: Mix acrylic cement powder with methyl methacrylate in a 1:1 ratio to prepare the dental cement.

steps.title: Cover skull with skin flaps
steps.instruction: Reposition the skin flaps over as much of the skull as possible without covering the anchoring screws.

steps.title: Secure assembly with dental cement
steps.instruction: Apply the dental cement, ensuring it fills the space under the screw heads and fixes the entire assembly in place; allow the cement to harden until almost dry.

steps.title: Release cannula and recover animal
steps.instruction: Carefully release the guide cannula from the stereotaxic arm, then remove the beak clamp and ear bars; let the chick recover for at least 5 days before beginning any injections.
